effect.tsuki.golden_heart.description: Removes all negative effects every 2 ticks
effect.tsuki.poisoning.description: Gives attacked mobs Poison II for 15s
effect.tsuki.scorpion.description: Gives attacked mobs Poison IV for 45s
effect.tsuki.seiran.description: Every second deals 10% max health damage, minimum 1.5, but leaves at least 0.5 HP
enchantment.tsuki.fresh_food.desc: Gives the player hunger and saturation when mining blocks.
enchantment.tsuki.omnitool.desc: Turns the item into a suitable mining tool for any block.
enchantment.tsuki.smash.desc: Quickly mines any block. If the tool is not suitable, no items will drop.
item.tsuki.glass_alexander.tooltip: A dessert cocktail based on brandy, blended with cognac, creme de cacao, and cream liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_americano.tooltip: Made by filling a glass with vermouth and Campari, then lengthening it with a little soda water.
item.tsuki.glass_aviation.tooltip: A cocktail mixed from gin, cherry liqueur, lemon juice, and violet liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_beer.tooltip: Ferocious TRANCE beats blast through the mysterious reaches of the internet...
item.tsuki.glass_beer_margarita.tooltip: One of the variations of the Margarita.
item.tsuki.glass_bellini.tooltip: Bellini is a cocktail that originated in Venice, Italy, made with Prosecco and peach puree or nectar.
item.tsuki.glass_between_the_sheets.tool: Made by mixing equal parts white rum with cognac or orange liqueur, then balancing with lemon juice.
item.tsuki.glass_black_russian.tooltip: Black Russian is a cocktail made from vodka and Kahlua coffee liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_bloody_mary.tooltip: Bloody Mary is made with vodka, tomato juice, and various spicy seasonings, a very adventurous cocktail.
item.tsuki.glass_boilermaker.tooltip: Made by dropping a shot of liquor, glass and all, into a large glass of beer.
item.tsuki.glass_cassis_orange.tooltip: Made by mixing blackcurrant juice with orange juice; it contains no alcohol.
item.tsuki.glass_cassis_soda.tooltip: Made by mixing blackcurrant juice with soda water; it contains no alcohol.
item.tsuki.glass_cuba_libre.tooltip: A highball made from cola, rum, and ice, often with a little lime juice added.
item.tsuki.glass_daiquiri.tooltip: Made from rum and lime juice.
item.tsuki.glass_eggnog.tooltip: Made by adding milk, cream, eggs, and spices such as cinnamon to cognac; it contains no alcohol.
item.tsuki.glass_flying_grasshopper.tool: Adds vodka to the Grasshopper, raising the alcohol content.
item.tsuki.glass_french_sevenfive.toolti: Named after a field gun, it is made by adding lemon juice and syrup to gin, straining, then topping with champagne.
item.tsuki.glass_gimlet.tooltip: Made by mixing gin with lime juice.
item.tsuki.glass_gin_fizz.tooltip: Made from gin, soda water, and lemon juice.
item.tsuki.glass_gin_tonic.tooltip: A highball cocktail made from gin and tonic water.
item.tsuki.glass_godfather.tooltip: Made by mixing Scotch whisky with amaretto.
item.tsuki.glass_godmother.tooltip: A Godfather in which the whisky is replaced with vodka.
item.tsuki.glass_grasshopper.tooltip: Made from cocoa liqueur and mint liqueur, rounded out with cream.
item.tsuki.glass_grog.tooltip: Also called watered rum, made by adding water or lemon juice to rum to improve the flavor.
item.tsuki.glass_highball.tooltip: Highball usually refers to a cocktail made with a small amount of spirits and a large amount of a non-alcoholic mixer. In Japanese, Highball especially refers to whisky mixed with soda water.
item.tsuki.glass_hot_buttered_rum.toolti: Made from dark rum, butter, brown sugar, and hot water.
item.tsuki.glass_hot_toddy.tooltip: Made from whisky, water, honey, lemon, and spices, and should be served hot.
item.tsuki.glass_john_collins.tooltip: Made by stirring together gin, soda water, lemon juice, and syrup.
item.tsuki.glass_kalimotxo.tooltip: Made by mixing equal parts red wine and cola.
item.tsuki.glass_kir.tooltip: Made from white wine, vodka, and blackcurrant liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_kir_royale.tooltip: Made by pouring plenty of champagne and soda water into blackcurrant liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_kitty.tooltip: A highball cocktail made from red wine and soda water.
item.tsuki.glass_lemon_margarita.tooltip: One of the variations of the Margarita.
item.tsuki.glass_long_island_iced_tea.to: Rum, gin, vodka, tequila, liqueur, lemon juice, and syrup, then topped with cola.
item.tsuki.glass_margarita.tooltip: Made by mixing tequila, liqueur, and lime juice, often with extra syrup and a thin salt rim.
item.tsuki.glass_martini.tooltip: Mixed from gin and vermouth, garnished with an olive or a strip of lemon peel; one of the most famous cocktails.
item.tsuki.glass_matador.tooltip: Made by mixing tequila, orange liqueur, and lime juice.
item.tsuki.glass_mimosa.tooltip: Made by mixing champagne and orange juice.
item.tsuki.glass_mint_julep.tooltip: Made with whisky and syrup, accented with mint and bitters, then stirred with crushed ice.
item.tsuki.glass_mojito.tooltip: Made from white rum, sugar, lime juice, and soda water, with mint added.
item.tsuki.glass_moscow_mule.tooltip: Made from vodka, beer, and lime juice, with many variations. It should be served in a copper mug.
item.tsuki.glass_negroni.tooltip: Made from gin, sweet vermouth, and Campari, then finished with an orange slice.
item.tsuki.glass_old_fashioned.tooltip: Built on whisky with sugar and bitters, then garnished with orange peel.
item.tsuki.glass_operator.tooltip: Built on white wine, then finished with ginger ale after adding lemon juice.
item.tsuki.glass_panache.tooltip: Made by mixing lemon juice and sugar into beer.
item.tsuki.glass_paradise.tooltip: Made by mixing gin, apricot brandy liqueur, orange juice, and lime juice, then adding a little bitters.
item.tsuki.glass_pina_colada.tooltip: Made from rum, pineapple juice, and coconut milk.
item.tsuki.glass_porchcrawler.tooltip: Made by mixing beer and lemon juice with various spirits such as vodka, rum, gin, or whisky.
item.tsuki.glass_porto_flip.tooltip: Made from cognac, port wine, syrup, and raw egg.
item.tsuki.glass_red_eye.tooltip: Made by mixing tomato juice, Worcestershire sauce, and syrup into beer.
item.tsuki.glass_russian_spring.tooltip: Made by shaking vodka, lemon juice, blackcurrant liqueur, and syrup, then topping with champagne.
item.tsuki.glass_rusty_nail.tooltip: Made by mixing equal parts whisky and liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_saketini.tooltip: One of the variations of the Martini, using sake in place of vermouth.
item.tsuki.glass_salty_dog.tooltip: Made from vodka and grapefruit juice, with a touch of chilled salt.
item.tsuki.glass_sangria.tooltip: Made from red wine and orange juice, often with sliced fruit.
item.tsuki.glass_scorpion.tooltip: Made from rum, cognac, orange juice, and lemon juice.
item.tsuki.glass_screwdriver.tooltip: Made by mixing vodka, orange juice, and syrup, then seasoning with bitters.
item.tsuki.glass_shandy_gaff.tooltip: Made from equal parts beer and ginger beer.
item.tsuki.glass_sidecar.tooltip: Made from cognac, orange liqueur, and lemon juice.
item.tsuki.glass_spritzer.tooltip: Made by mixing soda water into white wine.
item.tsuki.glass_stinger.tooltip: Made from cognac and white mint liqueur.
item.tsuki.glass_tequila_sunrise.tooltip: Mix tequila and orange juice, then slowly pour in grenadine to sink to the bottom.
item.tsuki.glass_whiskey_sour.tooltip: Made by mixing freshly squeezed lemon and syrup into whisky.
item.tsuki.magatama_white.tooltip: Grants creative flight while in your hotbar or Curios slot, but can reduce your max health.
item.tsuki.magatama_blue.tooltip: Use to convert weather at the cost of health. Cooldown: 60s.
item.tsuki.magatama_green.tooltip: Consumes all hunger, all saturation and a large amount of health to draw 32 crop or seed drops. Cooldown: 300s.
item.tsuki.magatama_orange.tooltip: Lets you eat when full, and converts saturation/hunger into healing with overflow to absorption.
item.tsuki.magatama_pink.tooltip: Every 60s when in hotbar or Curios slot refills hunger and saturation, and when used restores instantly. Cooldown: 60s.
item.tsuki.magatama_purple.tooltip: Pacifies monster aggro when in hotbar or Curios slot, but attacking triggers a 30s state where you take double damage.
item.tsuki.magatama_red.tooltip: Every 2s when in hotbar or Curios slot eradicates 32 blocks away phantoms, seagulls, vultures, and pixies, when used eradicates instantly.
item.tsuki.mythery_mix.tooltip:
A bottle of oddly purple liquid.
One sip brings together sweet peach, the bite of vodka, and the scent of roasted rabbit. Hmm... it actually tastes pretty good...
There is a small chance it contains a little Tskimi Seiran bathwater.
item.tsuki.shaker.no_alcohol: No base drink in the shaker

tsuki.config.bambooshot_weight.tooltip: Changes generate rate of BambooShot. Increase value to gen more BambooShot.
tsuki.config.give_guide_on_first_login.t: Gives the guide book to players the first time they join a world when GuideME is installed.
tsuki.config.iron_sand_amount.tooltip: Changes generate amount of Iron Sand. Increase value to gen more Iron Sand.
tsuki.config.mythic_pickaxe_allow_basic_: Make Mythic Pickaxe to upgrade Fortune or Silk Touch first when it has neither enchantment.
tsuki.config.mythic_pickaxe_exp_needed.t: Changes the experience needed to upgrade Mythic Pickaxe. Increase value to make it harder to upgrade.
tsuki.config.magatama_white_enable_penal: Enables the White Magatama max health penalty.
tsuki.config.magatama_white_penalty_heal: Sets the target max health while the White Magatama penalty is active.
tsuki.config.magatama_blue_health_cost.t: Sets the health cost consumed per Blue Magatama weather conversion.
tsuki.config.magatama_green_remaining_he: Sets how much health remains after using the Green Magatama.
tsuki.config.magatama_green_draw_count.t: Sets how many crop or seed drops the Green Magatama draws per use.
tsuki.config.magatama_white_enable_minin: Enables the White Magatama airborne mining speed compensation.
tsuki.config.magatama_white_mining_speed: Sets the White Magatama airborne mining speed compensation multiplier.
tsuki.config.pepper_weight.tooltip: Changes generate rate of Pepper. Increase value to gen more Pepper.
tsuki.config.vanilla_weight.tooltip: Changes generate rate of Vanilla. Increase value to gen more Vanilla.
